intro: One roti sardin has an estimated 480 kcal. The calories come from the roti canai dough and cooking oil, while the sardines give you decent protein.
diet: Yes, and it's one of the better mamak roti choices for protein. Sardines have protein and omega-3. But the dough and oil still keep the calories high. One piece with a less sweet drink is enough for one meal.
tips: Have just one piece and ask for kuah on the side.
Choose teh o or kopi o kurang manis.
Have some veggies or fruit after so you feel fuller.

swap.name: Tosai telur
swap.why: You still get protein from the egg, with less oil and dough. Saves you almost 200 kcal.

faq.q: Is the sardine in roti sardin from a can?
faq.a: Usually yes. It's canned sardine in tomato sauce, mashed with onion and chilli. Some shops add a bit of spice.

faq.q: Is roti sardin high in salt?
faq.a: Canned sardines do contain salt. If you're watching your blood pressure, take less kuah and skip the salty sambal.

faq.q: Can I make roti sardin with Gardenia bread?
faq.a: Yes, this home version is easier. Spread the sardine filling in the bread, then bake or toast without much oil.
